name.description: The package name, in kebab case, such as billing.

sections.description: The sections to make, separated by commas, such as types,models,repo,runtime. types is required. repo needs runtime and --record.

record.description: The first record, in kebab case. It gets a schema in types/, a model in models/ and a table in repo/, for each section the package has. Leave it out for a package that owns no records.

summary.description: One line, at most 120 characters, for the primitives registry.
